name: XeGTAO

adaptations.storageTextures: The bridge uses portable WebGPU R32_UINT/R32_FLOAT storage formats; generated UAV declarations are narrowed to write-only after a textureStore-only proof.
adaptations.scalarAoSaturation: R8_UINT-equivalent scalar AO stores are clamped to 255 when represented as R32_UINT (D3D11.3 Functional Specification, section 3.2.3.13). Packed R11G11B10 normal output is a separate texture and is not clamped.
adaptations.lineEndings: Vendored source integrity hashes canonicalize CRLF and trim terminal LF bytes; raw GitHub response hashes are retained above for provenance.

scope: Feasibility baseline only: FP32 depth, spatial Hilbert/R2 sequence, no temporal accumulation, no bent normals.
